_purpose: Synthetic evaluation corpus for intent classification, generic-question handling in particular (see backend/tests/test_generic_question_handling.py, which runs every case below through classify_intent()). This is what 'training' means for a deterministic, keyword-based classifier with no live LLM key: not gradient descent, but a labeled corpus the keyword lists in app/services/llm_client.py::INTENT_KEYWORDS are checked and expanded against, so coverage is verifiable and regression-tested rather than a vibe. Utterances are realistic full sentences (not bare keywords) so the test proves substring matching still works with a keyword embedded naturally in surrounding words, not just against the literal keyword string.
